description: UMA Dispute EV Desk — For a Polymarket market inside its roughly two-hour UMA challenge window, reads the live proposal on Polygon (adapter, optimistic oracle, bond, finalFee, expiry), judges P(proposal wrong or too early) against the literal rules with an ensemble plus red-team pass and verified quotes (full-game sports markets are decided by code with no model when Gamma's timestamps show the answer came before the g

evidenceUrls.description: Public pages to treat as evidence.

market.description: Polymarket slug, market/event URL, conditionId or questionID.

aprOpportunity.description: Annual opportunity cost of capital, default 0.15.

gasUsd.description: Total dispute transaction cost in USD; overrides the estimate.

minEdgeUsd.description: Minimum EV edge for DISPUTE, default 2.

otherDisputeProb.description: P(someone else disputes a wrong proposal if you abstain), default 0.3 (an unmeasured assumption; it only affects callers holding a position).

safetyMarginMinutes.description: Submit-by margin before the window closes, default 10.

avgPrice.description: Average entry price per share, USD.

outcome.description: Outcome label held, e.g. Yes, No or a team name.

prices.description: Current prices of the first and second listed outcomes, USD per share.

proposal.description: Overrides for on-chain proposal fields (what-if or replay). Omit to read the live proposal.

expirationTime.description: ISO-8601 UTC time the challenge window closes.

outcome.description: Proposed answer: first listed outcome (UMA price 1), second (price 0) or 50/50.

name: dispute-ev
